bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
ipc="$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
client="$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test -f "$ipc" && test -f "$client" || exit 62
test ! -L "$ipc" && test ! -L "$client" || exit 63
test ! "$(grep -l 'link_inline_query_smoke' "$ipc" || true)" || exit 64
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link62-inline.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp -p "$ipc" "$tmp/ipc.old"
cp -p "$client" "$tmp/client.old"
python3 -B - "$ipc" "$client" "$tmp" <<'PY'
import ast,pathlib,sys
f,c,t=map(pathlib.Path,sys.argv[1:])
def rep(s,a,b):
 if s.count(a)!=1:raise SystemExit(65)
 return s.replace(a,b,1)
s=f.read_text()
s=rep(s,'"link_registration_smoke",','"link_registration_smoke", "link_inline_query_smoke",')
s=rep(s,'    if set(request) != expected:',
'''    if action == "link_inline_query_smoke":
        expected={"request_id","action","code"}
    if set(request) != expected:''')
s=rep(s,'    if action == "link_registration_smoke":',
'''    if action == "link_inline_query_smoke":
        code=request["code"]
        if not isinstance(code,str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24}",code):
            raise ValueError("LINK_CODE_INVALID")
        bot=await client.get_entity("GayBBS_bot")
        if not getattr(bot,"bot",False):raise RuntimeError("LINK_BOT_INVALID")
        results=await client.inline_query(bot,code)
        if len(results)!=1:raise RuntimeError("LINK_INLINE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND")
        return {"request_id":request_id,"action":action,"status":"PASS",
                "inline_result_found":True}
    if action == "link_registration_smoke":''')
ast.parse(s);(t/"ipc.new").write_text(s)
s=c.read_text()
s=rep(s,'topic_ids: list[int] | None = None) -> dict:', 'topic_ids: list[int] | None = None, code: str | None = None) -> dict:')
s=rep(s,'        if action == "room_public_readback":',
'''        if action == "link_inline_query_smoke":
            if not isinstance(code,str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24}",code):
                raise ValueError("LINK_CODE_INVALID")
            request["code"]=code
        elif action == "room_public_readback":''')
s=rep(s,'elif chat_id is not None or message_id is not None or topic_ids is not None:',
'elif chat_id is not None or message_id is not None or topic_ids is not None or code is not None:')
s=rep(s,'    parser.add_argument("--chat-id", type=int)',
'    parser.add_argument("--code")\n    parser.add_argument("--chat-id", type=int)')
s=rep(s,'invoke(args.action, args.chat_id, args.message_id, topic_ids)',
'invoke(args.action, args.chat_id, args.message_id, topic_ids, args.code)')
ast.parse(s);(t/"client.new").write_text(s)
PY
restore(){
 cp -p "$tmp/ipc.old" "$ipc"
 cp -p "$tmp/client.old" "$client"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
cp "$tmp/ipc.new" "$ipc"
cp "$tmp/client.new" "$client"
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 66
(cd "$root/scripts" && python3 -B userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null) || exit 67
trap - ERR
echo LINK_INLINE_TEST_ADAPTER=READY
echo USERBOT_AUTH_HEALTH=PASS
